en: Colorized vintage view of a town with a fortified complex in the foreground, featuring a round brick tower with a steep conical roof and adjoining walls, surrounded by trees and open grassy areas with paths. Behind it rise densely packed houses on a hillside and low mountains. Several people stand on the path in the foreground. The word "Trento" is printed at the top left, with a handwritten date "12 IV 09" above the skyline.
